goal: Explicitly restrict CI workflow tokens to read-only repository contents access
Prevent workflow jobs in contributor forks from executing with unnecessary write privileges
agreement: Strong support because explicit least-privilege permissions harden CI and forks (real-or-random)
Supports making permissions explicit in the workflow configuration (maflcko)
Questioned practical benefit since upstream is already read-only and fork scoping is debated (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because upstream repository defaults already enforce read-only token permissions
Provides small hardening benefit by making least-privilege explicit and covering contributor forks
